summary: Cellectis S.A., a French Nasdaq-listed gene-editing biotech, filed a Form 6-K on Sept. 14, 2026, reporting a board-approved strategic transformation into an in vivo gene editing company, announced via press release. The board acted on Sept. 11, 2026. The company will advance two lead in vivo programs, .HEAL-101 for severe hypertriglyceridemia and .HEAL-201 for severe hypercholesterolemia, with preliminary Phase 1 data planned in H2 2027 and H1 2028, while exiting lasme-cel and eti-cel development and realigning operations to extend cash runway into H2 2028. No financial terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed.
